description: This PHP source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractVueController' that extends 'AbstractViewController'. It manages rendering Vue.js components within a web framework, handling template rendering, component management, and request processing.

classes.name: AbstractVueController
classes.description: An abstract controller class for managing Vue.js component rendering within a web framework, including request handling, template rendering, and component management.

methods.name: setTwig
methods.description: Sets the Twig environment used for rendering templates.

methods.name: setTemplate
methods.description: Sets the template filename for rendering.

methods.name: setComponent
methods.description: Assigns a Vue component to the controller, throws exception if already handled.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initialization method, meant to be overridden.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Hook executed before rendering, can be overridden.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the Vue component with the current context and template.

methods.name: postRender
methods.description: Hook executed after rendering, can be overridden.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Main request handler that manages pre-render, render, and post-render steps, returning a response.

methods.name: getContext
methods.description: Returns the attribute bag used for rendering context.

methods.name: handleBadRequest
methods.description: Handles bad request scenarios by setting a 'bad-request' component.

methods.name: setResponse
methods.description: Sets the response object and marks the request as handled.

methods.name: isHandled
methods.description: Checks if the request has been handled.

methods.name: setHandled
methods.description: Marks the request as handled or not.
